title: Lists of Applications Received for Faculty Positions – Advertisement Nos. 60, 61 & 62 (2025)
text:
Reference to the Advertisement No.
60 (2025)
,
61 (2025)
, and

62 (2025)
published in the national dailies
Aaj
,
Mashriq
, and

The News
, as well as on the University webpage dated
September 6, 2025
,
wherein applications were invited for the positions of
Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Lecturer
in various disciplines.

The details of applications submitted by the deadline for each advertisement are available below for information of all concerned.

Advertisement No. 60 (2025) (https://awkum.edu.pk/lists-of-applicants/Advertisement-No-60(2025).pdf)

Advertisement No. 61 (2025) (https://awkum.edu.pk/lists-of-applicants/Advertisement-No-61(2025).pdf)

Advertisement No. 62 (2025) (https://awkum.edu.pk/lists-of-applicants/Advertisement-No-62(2025).pdf)

Important Notes:

The list of applicants for various faculty positions has been arranged in
alphabetical order
for information of all concerned.

The list does
not constitute shortlisting or merit
at this stage.

The
eligibility and quantification
of applicants shall be determined by the Scrutiny & Quantification Committee in accordance with the prescribed University Statutes and Regulations.

For further details and updates, please continue visiting the
University webpage
.

Registrar
